normalized.result: Yes, that gives me plenty of direction. When there's nothing saved yet, the empty collection greets me with a friendly "Your collection starts here," a quick line about what will happen, and one obvious **Save your first bookmark** button that drops me straight into the same paste-a-link flow I already liked. And the Read later and Archive counts are still sitting there at zero on the side, so I can see the whole shape of the app even before I've added anything. For a first-time, empty state that's exactly what I'd want — I'm never left staring at a blank screen wondering what to do. This feels right.
